params.body: A judged reading sits folded to its head in the panel. Clicking its mark in the text (an approved citation, a bound number) asks to see it again: the passage, the question, the verdict. Until now the panel scrolled to the head and left it shut. One assertion added in review-page.test.js; all suites pass.
params.title: Review page: a judged reading unfolds when its mark is clicked
